_comment: Assassin chains. Same shape as sorcerer chains.json. confirmed = text in the skill pages names the link; estimated = id/text inference. Unlinked hidden skills (no parent found): Frenzied Accord 13150000, Surging Bloodlust 13170000, Prepare to Assassinate 13290000.

links.note: Quick Slice > Breaking Slice; same text pattern, restores 100 then 105 MP (ids/names; Inven/guide call it the Quick/Breaking/Swift slice basic chain)
Breaking Slice > Swift Slice; restores 105 then 120 MP, 0 cooldown, hits 2/3/4 per Metaroad
Savage Roar > Savage Back Kick; each engraves 1 Insignia for 10s, 120 MP, 0 cooldown
Savage Back Kick > Savage Smash; Savage Roar spec rank 16 text names [Savage Smash] ("Pulls nearby targets on using Savage Smash")
Throw Shadowblade spec rank 5: "Adds [Shadowblade Pursuit] Chain Skill"
Defiance spec rank 8: "Adds [Storm Slice] Chain Skill" (Storm Slice cd 120s -> 42s over ranks)
Infiltrate spec rank 12: "Adds [Dark Strike] Chain Skill"
Aerial Bind (Airborne) > Aerial Slaughter (makes target fall + Knockdown); id prefix 1323/1324, no text link
Ambush spec rank 12: "50% chance to trigger [Whirlwind Slice] on hit"
Shadow Fall proc child, same name/icon; "5% chance to trigger on attacking a target with Incapacitated Immunity"
Heart Gore proc child (passive, same text, same icon); the on-crit trigger
Heart Gore fires only on landing a Critical Hit (text); Exploit Weakness adds +100 Critical Hit
Illusive Clone removes Heart Gore cooldown for 10s
Inven Sep 30 guide: holding Storm Rampage during stagger cancels into Heart Gore faster; Storm Rampage requires a Staggered target
Shadowstrike Stuns; Shadow Fall requires a target afflicted with Stun (spec rank 16 also Blind)
Apply Poison passive (13730000) vs hidden active Apply Poison (13160000, 20% Poison 6s, cd 30s); relation not documented; likely older/variant form
